title.en: Diwali at the Embassy of India

text.en: On Saturday evening, 7 November 2026, we sang kirtan outdoors at the Embassy of India in Zagreb, for Diwali, the Festival of Lights. Under the festival banner, with guitars, djembe, tambourine and many voices, the evening filled with mantras and warmth. Thank you to the Embassy of India, and to everyone who came and sang with us.
text.hr: U subotu navečer, 7. studenoga 2026., pjevali smo kirtan na otvorenom, u Veleposlanstvu Indije u Zagrebu, za Diwali, festival svjetla. Pod festivalskim plakatom, uz gitare, džembe, tamburin i mnogo glasova, večer se ispunila mantrama i toplinom. Hvala Veleposlanstvu Indije i svima koji su došli i pjevali s nama.

credit.hr: Kadrovi iz našeg videa s koncerta.
